main_body: East-facing pew with wooden backrest on the left (rows 8-46) and seat with two red cushions on the right (rows 13-46).
top_band: Wooden seat surface with two red seat cushions (rows 13-40)
evidence: This is an east-facing pew seen in 3/4 view. The backrest is on the left (rows 8-40, front edge 40-46) and the horizontal seat surface extends to the right with two red cushions visible from above (rows 13-40), followed by a front edge highlight at row 42 and the vertical front face of the seat base below (rows 43-46).

style.evidence: The candidate consists of large, completely flat geometric blocks of color (e.g., the two 5x10 solid bright red cushion rectangles and the uniform brown backrest strip) with no wood grain, fabric shading, or surface texture, looking much flatter and simpler than the Beodeul references.
